notes: Homeopathic OTC drug CGMP letter (non-sterile) citing inadequate batch microbial testing (21 CFR 211.165(b)) and quality-unit/data-integrity failures (211.22(d)), including discarded out-of-trend records and a batch that FDA border testing found microbiologically contaminated. All specific product/batch identifiers are redacted as (b)(4) throughout and none is named in clear, so products is [] and product_redacted is true. recall_concern is true because FDA explicitly discusses testing retain samples and 'notifying customers and product recalls,' not a boilerplate CAPA mention. contamination_present is true because FDA testing found actual microbiological contamination in a specific detained batch.
